advancedArguments.name: date
advancedArguments.description: Date of the existing manual in and out record to edit. Use the format returned by the dateFormat tool (MM/DD/YYYY for en-US, otherwise DD/MM/YYYY). Ask the user for this if not provided.

raw.description: Date of the existing manual in and out record to edit. Use the format returned by the dateFormat tool (MM/DD/YYYY for en-US, otherwise DD/MM/YYYY). Ask the user for this if not provided.

advancedArguments.name: inDate
advancedArguments.description: In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the Out Date - do not assume it. The tool returns the row's own date under suggested.inDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

raw.description: In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the Out Date - do not assume it. The tool returns the row's own date under suggested.inDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

advancedArguments.name: inTime
advancedArguments.description: New In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. Whenever a time is being changed, ask the user separately for the In Date, In Time, Out Date and Out Time and pass all four. Omit them all only when the user is changing just the break.

raw.description: New In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. Whenever a time is being changed, ask the user separately for the In Date, In Time, Out Date and Out Time and pass all four. Omit them all only when the user is changing just the break.

advancedArguments.name: outDate
advancedArguments.description: Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the In Date - never decide it yourself. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. The tool reports whether this shift can end on the following day as current.shiftCanEndNextDay, and returns the row's own date under suggested.outDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

raw.description: Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the In Date - never decide it yourself. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. The tool reports whether this shift can end on the following day as current.shiftCanEndNextDay, and returns the row's own date under suggested.outDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

advancedArguments.name: outTime
advancedArguments.description: New Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. Ask for it together with inDate, inTime and outDate. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. Check it against outDate, not against inTime.

raw.description: New Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. Ask for it together with inDate, inTime and outDate. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. Check it against outDate, not against inTime.

advancedArguments.name: reason
advancedArguments.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being changed. Required before the update is submitted. No reason is needed for the break times on their own.

raw.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being changed. Required before the update is submitted. No reason is needed for the break times on their own.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview of current vs new values and explicitly confirmed. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without updating anything.

raw.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview of current vs new values and explicitly confirmed. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without updating anything.

advancedArguments.name: breakInTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

raw.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

advancedArguments.name: breakOutTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

raw.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

advancedArguments.name: dateSelectMode
advancedArguments.description: Search Criteria date selection mode, matching the page radio buttons: last7days (Last 7 Days), last30days (Last 30 Days), period (By Period, uses fromDate/toDate). Defaults to period with a wide range.

raw.description: Search Criteria date selection mode, matching the page radio buttons: last7days (Last 7 Days), last30days (Last 30 Days), period (By Period, uses fromDate/toDate). Defaults to period with a wide range.

advancedArguments.name: fromDate
advancedArguments.description: Search range start date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being edited must fall inside the range.

raw.description: Search range start date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being edited must fall inside the range.

advancedArguments.name: toDate
advancedArguments.description: Search range end date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being edited must fall inside the range.

raw.description: Search range end date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being edited must fall inside the range.

advancedArguments.name: isGroupByEmployee
advancedArguments.description: Optional Group By Employee checkbox on the Search Criteria panel. Defaults to false.

raw.description: Optional Group By Employee checkbox on the Search Criteria panel. Defaults to false.

advancedArguments.name: rosterGroup
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster group id used to load the roster list via GetRostersByGroupId. Defaults to 1.

raw.description: Optional roster group id used to load the roster list via GetRostersByGroupId. Defaults to 1.

advancedArguments.name: rosterCode
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000017. Defaults to 000017. Takes precedence over rosterName.

raw.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000017. Defaults to 000017. Takes precedence over rosterName.

advancedArguments.name: rosterName
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'Roster 1'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list. Ignored when rosterCode is given.

raw.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'Roster 1'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list. Ignored when rosterCode is given.
